statusDefinitions.PREVIEW_GENERATION_REQUIRED: Source is eligible but needs deterministic Visual Library/Atlas preview generation.
statusDefinitions.TRUE_UNEXPLAINED_MISS: No explicit supported reason explains why a Director visual lacks usable CURRENT pixel evidence. Treat as RED engineering investigation.
